title: First-person shooter
summary: A small browser FPS in three.js: an arena with obstacles, waves of enemies that path around cover, recoil, muzzle flash, hit feedback, HUD, start and game-over screens. Every model, texture and sound generated in code.
watchFor: Atmosphere: lighting, fog, materials, sound design (open it live)
Weapon feel: recoil, muzzle flash, hit markers
Enemy behaviour: do they navigate obstacles or get stuck?
Completeness: HUD, reload, waves, game over
interaction: The same scripted input for every model: press Play, move, strafe, turn and fire for 40 seconds.
